display_name: 无标签多尺度复数频谱恢复与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 配对验证
description: 冻结 DURA，使用配对源域 IQ、双时频分辨率复数乘性滤波和低信噪比保护门；不使用发射机标签或分类器训练/选模，源波形选择后接冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL。
authorization: 本对话持续研发 Phase1 星地恢复网络，全部场景较 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 干净基座下降不超过 3%；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python; CPU only, two threads; no CUDA workers

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six registered Phase1 TX; no TX labels used in training or source IQ selection
data.validation_ref: Source L_s/U_s holdout by receiver/day; no source V read
data.leo_config_ref: practical low suburban/mid urban/low urban, post_sync residual, no added equalization; final Phase1 clean plus six practical views

permissions.query_use: Phase1 test only after source-IQ selection frozen and all predictions sealed; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed Phase1 development evaluation; historical test observations mean not independent blind

checkpoint.initialization: new mask scratch; DURA frozen; Tri-SIG-TIME SSL used only after source IQ selection
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: prior.frozen_dura validates original 7/63/30 source-only lineage; core.data matches exact Tri-SIG-TIME role IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source IQ-only normalized MSE over receiver 4/6 day3; no per-receiver/per-scene regression; epochs 2/5/10 and alpha .25/.5/1; retain DURA if no passing improvement; no F or TX used

execution.launch_owner: Codex current chat phase1-complex-mask single owner
execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two threads, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; preserve other owners

execution.stop_rule: Only provenance/role violation, output collision, nonfinite or technical execution failure; preserve all partial outputs; no stop for low performance

dimensions: clean and six Phase1 practical scenes
source real L_s and confident U_s pseudo targets
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Target all six restored accuracies >= clean baseline minus 3 pp, also report relative 3% threshold; clean damage <=1 pp; source IQ selection fixed before F or source labels.

rows.method: two-resolution bounded complex multiplicative STFT masks with fixed blind gate, DURA frozen, no F or TX training
rows.seed_notes: Support null: Phase1 no support. Evaluation seed controls simulated receiver hardware; source sample/augmentation/model seeds fixed; baseline model seed 2026092701.
rows.scenario: source clean plus three impaired views; seven Phase1 final test views only if source IQ selects mask
rows.budget_ref: 4096 sampled L_s/U_s IDs; 10 source epochs, two CPU threads

notes: No classifier weight/output or TX labels used during source model optimization or source IQ selection.
F and L_s labels only opened after source selection; confident U_s pseudo-targets used for source evaluation only.
Previous Phase1 development results observed, so final comparisons are nonblind and not clean generalization claims.
If source IQ selection retains DURA, no new mask checkpoint or target predictions are launched.
